reviews.text: It's a good clinic, we take our dog there for routine vaccinations.
Very helpful and attentive. The doctor explained everything very well. Maximum friendliness.

I take my dog ​​Shiva to this veterinary clinic and I couldn't be happier! From day one, we have always been very well received, with affection and professionalism. The team is extremely attentive, dedicated and treats animals with the respect and care they deserve. Whenever Shiva has had a problem, they have been able to solve it efficiently and transparently, explaining everything in detail.
I recommend it 100% to anyone looking for quality and reliable care for their pets and more!
Excellent and very attentive professionals! I recommend them!
Five-star people, thank you to veterinarian Lara and assistant André for everything they have done for my little caramel cookie.

Excellent service. I was hesitant to change veterinarians due to previous negative experiences, but this time I was pleasantly surprised. They explain everything in detail about what will happen during the consultation, and everything is done with care and patience to ensure our pet is comfortable. Thank you, Dr. Laura, for the kindness with which you care for our furry friends.
We really enjoyed it!

Very friendly and helpful staff! They also reply fast in WhatsApp and in case any serious procedure is required can contact main clinic in Alfragide.
My cats also like, when the vet gives them treats during consultations :)

I feel safe taking my kitten, Bub, to the pet24 clinic in Ameixoeira. I can say that they saved Bub 5 months ago, detecting a uterine infection in a timely manner. The veterinarians and assistants are very kind. I recommend them.
Excellent service and treatment. I entrust the lives of my animals to the professionals at this clinic. I highly recommend them!

I've been to so many vets and never actively recommended any until I found this one. They treat my dog ​​with attention and affection like I've never seen before. I can only thank them for their patience in dealing with stressful situations for my dog ​​and all the pampering they give him. When we pass by, my dog ​​begs to go in. He knows he's so well treated there. :)
